provenance: Newly authored practice; not official PYQ
question_text: Under Telangana Rising 2047, which regional description is correctly matched?

options.A: CURE — rural-agriculture economy beyond the Regional Ring Road
options.B: PURE — peri-urban economy connecting the Outer Ring Road and Regional Ring Road
options.C: RARE — high-density core urban economy within the Outer Ring Road
options.D: CURE — a constitutional urban-government tier created by the Seventy-Fourth Amendment

option_assessment.A: Incorrect. The government vision defines the rural/agriculture zone beyond RRR as RARE, not CURE.
option_assessment.B: Correct. The government vision places PURE between ORR and RRR and describes its manufacturing focus.
option_assessment.C: Incorrect. The area within ORR is CURE; RARE extends beyond RRR.
option_assessment.D: Incorrect. CURE is an economic/planning region defined by state vision, not a constitutional tier created by the 74th Amendment. The 74th Amendment establishes a constitutional framework for municipalities, not CURE.

primary_sources.publisher: Telangana government, Telangana State Warehousing Corporation hosted copy
